newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares trim losses at close on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: French shares trim losses at close on Tuesday.

text.p: French shares trimmed their losses at the close on Tuesday in lacklustre holiday volume after sinking earlier on fears of a German rate hike to protect the mark.

Dealers remained cautious but believed the Bundesbank was unlikely to boost rates. "People think the German economy is not yet in a fit state to raise rates," said one trader. He said the CAC-40 could come under further modest pressure on Wednesday, testing technical support around 2,964, but the move by the French market to claw back some of its losses in the afternoon "shows there is no sign of panic."
* CAC-40 index closed down 8.31, or 0.28 percent, at 2,984.1.
* CAC-40 Aug futures 2,989 vs 2,997 at Mondays close.
